verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.140
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.140

verses.pali: 14. Yodhājīvavagga
verses.english: 14. A Warrior

verses.pali: Assakhaḷuṅkasutta
verses.english: A Wild Colt

verses.pali: “Tayo ca, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅke desessāmi tayo ca purisakhaḷuṅke.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you about three wild colts and three wild people.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo assakhaḷuṅkā?
verses.english: “What are the three wild colts?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: One wild colt is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: Another wild colt is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: While another wild colt is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo assakhaḷuṅkā.
verses.english: These are the three wild colts.

verses.pali: Katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo purisakhaḷuṅkā?
verses.english: And what are the three wild people?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: One wild person is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: Another wild person is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: While another wild person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
verses.english: And how is a wild person fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant truly understands: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.

verses.pali: Idamassa javasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho saṁsādeti, no vissajjeti.
verses.english: But when asked a question about the teaching or training, they falter without answering.

verses.pali: Idamassa na vaṇṇasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re not beautiful, I say.

verses.pali: Na kho pana lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: And they don’t receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Idamassa na ārohapariṇāhasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re not well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: This is how a wild person is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
verses.english: And how is a wild person fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant truly understands: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.

verses.pali: Idamassa javasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.

verses.pali: Idamassa vaṇṇasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re beautiful, I say.

verses.pali: Na pana lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: But they don’t receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Idamassa na ārohapariṇāhasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re not well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: This is how a wild person is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
verses.english: And how is a wild person fast, beautiful, and well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant truly understands: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.

verses.pali: Idamassa javasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.

verses.pali: Idamassa vaṇṇasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re beautiful, I say.

verses.pali: Lābhī kho pana hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: They receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Idamassa ārohapariṇāhasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: This is how a wild person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo purisakhaḷuṅkā”ti.
verses.english: These are the three wild people.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
